title: SOC Engineering, Principal Engineer (STA)
jobDescription:
Job Description Benefits Culture How We Hire Overview Our Hardware Engineers at Synopsys are responsible for designing and developing cutting-edge semiconductor solutions. They work on intricate tasks such as chip architecture, circuit design, and verification to ensure the efficiency and reliability of semiconductor products. These engineers play a crucial role in advancing technology and enabling innovations in various industries. Play Video Job Description Date posted 04/22/2026 Category Engineering Hire Type Employee Job ID 16909 Remote Eligible No Date Posted 04/22/2026 We Are: At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation. You Are: You are a passionate and driven STA Expert with a strong technical leadership and execution skills in Static Timing Analysis and design timing & power closure flows and methodologies. You have a proven ability to lead and deliver complex designs to tapeout. With at least 12 years of hands-on experience in advanced technology nodes such as 7nm, 5nm, or even 3nm, you thrive in fast-paced, innovative environments and are eager to tackle new technical challenges. Your expertise spans the entire timing closure spectrum—from constraints development, validation, static timing analysis (STA), power analysis, Timing & power ECO generation. You may also have good understanding and working experience of synthesis, and Formal verification. You have experience in both block-level and full-chip expertise, and you’re adept at developing and validating timing constraints and closing timing on aggressive schedules. Your toolset includes industry-leading Synopsys solutions like Prime Time, Prime Power, PT-PX, Prime Closure, Tweaker allowing you to deliver optimal solutions for high-frequency, low-power designs. Beyond your technical skills, you are a collaborative team player who communicates effectively across global teams, valuing diversity of thought and experience. You are motivated by problem-solving, have a keen analytical mindset, and are always seeking opportunities to automate and optimize workflows using Python, PERL, TCL, or other scripting languages. You take ownership of your work and pride yourself on delivering high-quality, robust solutions that drive organizational success. If you are excited about contributing to leading-edge silicon design and want to make a tangible impact, Synopsys is the place for you. What You’ll Be Doing: Independently own and drive signoff static timing analysis and timing closure for advanced process nodes (7nm/5nm/3nm), ensuring successful tape-outs. Execute static timing analysis (STA), power analysis, synthesis and timing/power closure to meet stringent performance and power targets. Develop and validate timing constraints at block-level or Full So C level. Knowledge of synthesis, clock tree structures, implementation and STA tool correlation, impact of constraints on physical implementation, parasitic extraction, and formal verification will be preferred. Collaborate with cross-functional teams across geographies to resolve complex design challenges and ensure design quality and schedule adherence. Utilize and optimize Synopsys EDA tools, including Prime Power, PT-PX, Prime Closure, and Tweaker to deliver state-of-the-art silicon solutions. Develop and maintain automation scripts in Python, PERL, TCL, or other relevant languages to streamline design flows and improve efficiency. Contribute to the continuous improvement of static timing analysis flows and methodologies and best practices, sharing insights and mentoring junior engineers as needed. The Impact You Will Have: Accelerate the delivery of high-performance, low-power silicon solutions that power next-generation technology platforms worldwide. Enable Synopsys customers to achieve first-pass silicon success through robust and innovative physical design implementations. Drive technical excellence and best practices within the team, influencing the future direction of static timing analysis and timing closure methodologies at Synopsys. Foster a collaborative and inclusive culture by working seamlessly with global teams and sharing technical expertise. Contribute to Synopsys’ leadership in EDA tools adoption, providing valuable feedback to enhance product offerings and customer satisfaction. Support strategic customer engagements and help expand Synopsys' presence in the semiconductor ecosystem through successful project outcomes. What You’ll Need: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (BE/BTech/MTech or equivalent) in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 12+ years of relevant experience in static timing analysis, particularly in advanced technology nodes (7nm/5nm/3nm). Comprehensive hands-on experience of constraints development, validation, static timing analysis (STA), power analysis, Timing and power ECO generation. Proficiency with Synopsys EDA tools such as Prime Time, PT-PX, Prime Closure, Tweaker. Working experience with Synopsys tools like Fusion Compiler, Design Compiler, Formality, and Star RC. Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, PERL, TCL, or similar languages. Solid understanding of timing constraints development, validation, static timing analysis and closure, for both block-level and full-chip designs. Exposure to high-frequency design and low-power design methodologies. Who You Are: Proactive, self-motivated, and driven to achieve technical excellence. Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills with a keen attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, comfortable working in diverse and global teams. Collaborative team player who values knowledge sharing and mentoring others. Adaptable and open to learning new technologies and methodologies in a rapidly evolving field. The Team You’ll Be A Part Of: You’ll join a world-class team of backend and static timing analysis engineers at Synopsys, dedicated to delivering innovative system design solutions for our global customers. Our team thrives on collaboration, technical excellence, and a shared passion for pushing the boundaries of semiconductor design. Working closely with experts across multiple domains, you will play a key role in empowering customers to achieve their silicon goals while contributing to Synopsys’ leadership in the industry. Rewards and Benefits: We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. title: Applications Engineering, Sr Staff Engineer
jobDescription:
requirements and pain points back to Synopsys R&D teams Expand adoption of Synopsys Interface IP across high-growth markets including automotive, AI accelerators, and hyperscale data centers Contribute to the success of next-generation products that depend on high-speed, low-latency connectivity in increasingly complex system architectures Build internal knowledge and best practices that improve how Synopsys supports customers across the entire applications engineering organization What You'll Need Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with focus on VLSI or digital design 10+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC/So C design, verification, or applications engineering with exposure to full tape-out cycles Deep working knowledge of at least one high-speed protocol: Ethernet (10G/25G/50G/100G/400G), PCIe (Gen3/Gen4/Gen5), or DDR (DDR4/DDR5/LPDDR5) Strong RTL coding skills in Verilog or VHDL, with ability to read, debug, and modify customer design code Practical experience with simulation (VCS, Model Sim, Xcelium), synthesis (Design Compiler, Genus), and static timing analysis (Prime Time, Tempus) in a UNIX/Linux environment Familiarity with clock domain crossing (CDC), reset domain crossing (RDC), lint, DFT, and logical equivalence checking (LEC) is a strong plus Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences Who You Are You can take a vague customer problem description, ask three clarifying questions, and walk away with a clear action plan that actually solves the issue You are comfortable working across time zones and cultures, adapting your communication style to meet customers where they are technically and operationally You manage multiple customer engagements at once without dropping threads, keeping stakeholders informed and issues moving toward resolution You know when to dig in and solve a problem yourself and when to pull in specialists from R&D, and you do both without ego You are willing to travel occasionally for customer visits, training sessions, and on-site bring-up support when the situation calls for it You stay current with industry trends and protocol evolution because you understand that what you learned five years ago is not enough for what customers are building today The Team You'll Be Part Of Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. title: Application Engineering, Engineer
jobDescription:
requirements into working web solutions that fit their actual use cases Build, deploy, and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate code generation, improve UI/UX prototyping, debug more effectively, and increase test coverage Contribute to code reviews, write clear documentation, and help maintain code quality standards across development projects Participate in technical demos and customer presentations to show case solutions, gather feedback, and support adoption of new capabilities The Impact You Will Have You will deliver web applications that make complex simulation workflows accessible and usable for engineers who depend on them to meet project deadlines Your backend services and APIs will enable automation that saves customers hours of manual configuration and data handling per project cycle The solutions you build will directly influence how customers adopt and scale simulation-driven design processes across their engineering teams Your collaboration with product teams will surface real-world usage patterns that shape roadmap priorities and improve tool usability based on actual customer needs Your containerized deployments and CI/CD pipelines will reduce release cycles and improve reliability for customer-facing solutions You will bridge the gap between advanced simulation technology and practical engineering workflows, making powerful capabilities accessible to users who are not simulation experts Your contributions to code quality and documentation will raise development standards for the team and accelerate onboarding for future engineers What You'll Need You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Software Engineering, or a related field with 2+ years of professional software development experience, or a Master's degree with relevant project or internship experience You bring strong proficiency in Python for backend development, including hands-on experience with Python-based web or UI frameworks You have working knowledge of frontend development concepts and UI/UX principles, with the ability to translate user needs into functional interfaces that people actually want to use You are comfortable using Git for version control in a collaborative team environment where multiple people are working in the same codebase You have a solid understanding of core backend and infrastructure concepts, including RESTful API design, network fundamentals, and database systems, enabling you to effectively contribute to robust, full-stack application development. You communicate clearly in written and spoken English and can explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders without losing the important details Experience with the Ansys software ecosystem , Py Ansys , or similar scientific and engineering application domains is a plus, as is familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipelines Who You Are You can sit with a customer or internal stakeholder, listen to what they are trying to accomplish, and walk away with enough clarity to start building without needing every detail spelled out in advance When you review code or see a UI that does not quite work, you speak up with specific suggestions instead of just noting that something feels off, and you do it in a way that helps the team move forward You manage multiple threads at once without dropping details, a bug fix, a new feature request, and a deployment can all be in flight and you know exactly where each one stands You are comfortable working across time zones and cultures, adjusting your communication style so that nothing gets lost in translation and everyone stays aligned You test your own work thoroughly before handing it off because you know that catching issues early saves everyone time downstream and builds trust with the people depending on your code You are genuinely curious about how simulation and engineering tools get used in the real world, and that curiosity makes you ask better questions and build better solutions The Team You'll Be Part Of You will join the Ansys Customer Excellence team, working at the intersection of engineering simulation, modern software platforms, and AI-enabled solutions. This is a technical role where you will collaborate with customers, internal product teams, and engineers across geographies to shape how simulation technologies are integrated into scalable, cloud-native platforms. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, current initiatives, and collaboration model during the interview process. Rewards and Benefits We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. title: Staff Software Engineer, Meshing R&D ( C++, Meshing, GenAI, LLM)
jobDescription:
Job Description Benefits Culture How We Hire Overview Synopsys software engineers are key enablers in the world of Electronic Design Automation (EDA), developing and maintaining software used in chip design, verification and manufacturing. They work on assignments like designing, developing, and troubleshooting software, leveraging the state-of-the-art technologies like AI/ML, Gen AI and Cloud. Their critical contributions enable world-wide EDA designers to extend the frontiers of semiconductors and chip development. Play Video Job Description Date posted 07/29/2026 Category Engineering Hire Type Employee Job ID 18289 Remote Eligible No Date Posted 07/29/2026 We Are Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. You Are You have spent years building software where the geometry matters, where a mesh that looks fine in a demo falls apart under real loads. You know that meshing is not just discretization, it is the foundation that everything downstream depends on, and you have learned to balance mathematical rigor with performance constraints that actually ship. You are comfortable moving between C++ performance work, C# tooling, and Python scripting. Lately, you have been experimenting with LLMs, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows because you see real potential to accelerate how engineers interact with simulation workflows. You do not need a perfect spec to get started. You ask the right questions and find a path through ambiguity without creating technical debt. Debugging does not intimidate you. Whether it is a segfault in a million-line C++ codebase or a model that behaves differently on GPU versus CPU, you dig in and figure it out. At Synopsys, you will work on meshing capabilities that power mechanical simulation products, and what you build will directly affect how engineers solve real-world problems. What You'll Be Doing Design, develop, and maintain core meshing algorithms and frameworks in C++ and C# that support mechanical simulation workflows across Synopsys products Integrate meshing capabilities into flagship mechanical analysis products, working closely with product, solver, and platform engineering teams Build and prototype Gen AI-powered features using LLMs, RAG, MCP, Langchain, or Langgraph to improve simulation setup, automation, or user workflows Debug and optimize complex meshing code across Windows and Linux environments, including low-level performance tuning and GPU acceleration where applicable Collaborate with mechanical engineers and domain experts to ensure meshing outputs meet the needs of structural, fluids, and thermal analysis use cases Contribute to software design and architecture decisions that shape the long-term direction of meshing infrastructure Work with minimal supervision, owning features end to end from design through deployment and maintenance The Impact You Will Have Your meshing algorithms will directly influence the accuracy, speed, and reliability of simulations used by engineers solving real-world mechanical and fluids problems across industries Your architectural decisions will set the foundation for meshing capabilities that scale across multiple products and platforms The performance optimizations you implement will reduce solve times, lower computational costs, and improve user experience for engineers running large-scale simulations Your collaboration across teams will ensure meshing infrastructure evolves in lockstep with solver, geometry, and platform advancements The quality, maintainability, and extensibility of your code will enable future engineers to build on solid ground rather than work around legacy constraints The Gen AI-powered features you prototype will shape how simulation users interact with complex workflows, potentially transforming setup time from hours to minutes Your technical leadership will influence both product direction and engineering culture, setting standards for how the team approaches complex computational geometry problems What You'll Need Bachelor's degree with 7+ years or advanced degree with 5+ years of experience in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Computational Engineering, or related field Strong proficiency in C++ for performance-critical systems, with demonstrated experience architecting and delivering meshing algorithms, computational geometry systems, or CAE software Solid grounding in software design, architecture, debugging, and development in large, complex codebases Working knowledge of C# and Python for tooling, scripting, workflow automation, or API development Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex technical challenges where the path forward is not immediately obvious Advanced expertise in meshing algorithms, computational geometry, or CAE software development, with a track record of solving complex technical problems is highly desirable Familiarity with mechanical engineering domains like structural analysis, fluids, or thermal simulation is a plus, as is experience with Dev Ops practices, GPU programming, or cross-platform development on Windows and Linux Who You Are You do not wait for perfect information or fully baked requirements. You work with what you have, ask clarifying questions, align stakeholders, and move forward without creating downstream confusion or technical debt Debugging energizes you rather than drains you, whether it is a memory leak, a numerical instability, a workflow that breaks only on certain hardware configurations, or a performance regression that appeared three commits ago You have a strong point of view on software design and architecture, and you push back when an approach will not scale, when a feature request is missing critical context, or when a shortcut will cost the team later You are comfortable working across teams and time zones, coordinating with product managers, domain experts, solver engineers, and platform teams to land complex features that require alignment across multiple stakeholders You take ownership seriously. When you commit to delivering something, it gets done, it gets done right, and you leave the codebase and the team better than you found them You can explain a complex technical tradeoff to a product manager in two sentences without losing the nuance, and you can translate a vague user request into a concrete technical plan The Team You'll Be Part Of You will join the meshing team within Synopsys Simulation and Analysis, focused on exposing and integrating core meshing capabilities into mechanical flagship products. This is a team that works at the intersection of computational geometry, mechanical engineering, and software architecture, and your work will directly shape how simulation users experience meshing across the product portfolio. The team is global, collaborative, and deeply technical, and you will have the opportunity to influence both product direction and engineering culture. You will work closely with solver teams, platform engineers, product managers, and domain experts who depend on the infrastructure you build. Rewards and Benefits We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. title: Physical Design, Principal Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description Benefits Culture How We Hire Overview Our Hardware Engineers at Synopsys are responsible for designing and developing cutting-edge semiconductor solutions. They work on intricate tasks such as chip architecture, circuit design, and verification to ensure the efficiency and reliability of semiconductor products. These engineers play a crucial role in advancing technology and enabling innovations in various industries. Play Video Job Description Date posted 07/28/2026 Category Engineering Hire Type Employee Job ID 15091 Remote Eligible No Date Posted 07/28/2026 Job Title: Principal ASIC Physical Design Engineer We Are Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. You Are You are the person teams turn to when timing closure looks impossible and the clock tree feels like a puzzle with missing pieces. You know the difference between a design that passes signoff and one that ships with margin to spare, because you have spent years making those calls at 7nm and below. You do not just push buttons in ICC2 or Prime Time—you know why a constraint matters, and you catch issues before they ripple downstream. When someone asks about integrating a tricky mixed-signal macro, you have a mental toolkit of what can go wrong and how to make it work. You thrive on the hard problems: GHz-level timing, power optimization, and the reality of silicon bring-up. You want your work to show up in real products, not just in a tapeout report. Sharing what you know is second nature—mentoring junior engineers, reviewing a teammate’s floorplan, or explaining a tradeoff to a colleague in the US. You care about getting the details right, but you do not get stuck in them. You move projects forward, ask the right questions, and always look for a better way to do things. What You'll Be Doing Implement and integrate Physical Design for ASICs at advanced nodes (10nm, 7nm, 6nm and below) using tools like Synopsys ICC2, Prime Time, and Star RC. Drive timing closure for high-frequency designs above 4GHz, handling constraint management, analysis, and optimization. Work hands-on with clock tree synthesis, skew balancing, and robust clock distribution for complex So Cs and IPs. Collaborate closely with teams in Bangalore and the US, joining technical discussions, design reviews, and troubleshooting sessions. Integrate mixed-signal hard macro IPs, solving unique interface and floorplan challenges as they arise. Mentor junior engineers, sharing best practices and elevating the team’s technical capability. Develop and optimize automation scripts in Tcl, Perl, or Python to streamline physical design flows and improve productivity. Support and improve methodologies for floorplanning, placement, routing, and power optimization. The Impact You Will Have Deliver HPC Controller IPs that will power the next wave of consumer and enterprise devices. Push Synopsys’ reputation for silicon-proven, high-performance IP at the most advanced process nodes. Raise the bar for quality and innovation in timing closure, clock tree synthesis, and mixed-signal integration. Help global teams align and execute, ensuring projects hit milestones and customers get what they need, on time. Enable faster, more robust tapeouts by improving design flows and mentoring the next generation of engineers. Influence product differentiation through hands-on technical contributions and creative problem solving. Shorten time-to-market for customers by anticipating and solving critical design challenges early. What You'll Need Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related field. 10+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC physical design at 10nm, 7nm, 6nm or below. Deep proficiency with Synopsys ICC2, Prime Time, Star RC, and similar industry tools. Demonstrated success in timing closure for high-frequency designs (4GHz and above), including constraint management and analysis. Practical experience integrating HPC Controller interface IPs and mixed-signal macros. Solid knowledge of scripting (Tcl, Perl, Python) for automating physical design tasks. Strong skills in debugging complex design and integration issues. Who You Are You explain why a timing violation matters, not just how to fix it, and adapt your message for a peer or a VP. When a design review gets stuck, you break down the complexity and help the team move forward. You spot risk early and act, rather than waiting for issues to escalate. Sharing knowledge is second nature—you mentor, document, and help others level up. You keep an eye on quality, even under pressure, and push for continuous improvement in tools and process. You are comfortable switching context between deep technical work and cross-site collaboration, always keeping the larger goal in view. The Team You'll Be Part Of Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. Rewards and Benefits We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Job Description Benefits Culture How We Hire Overview Our Hardware Engineers at Synopsys are responsible for designing and developing cutting-edge semiconductor solutions. They work on intricate tasks such as chip architecture, circuit design, and verification to ensure the efficiency and reliability of semiconductor products. These engineers play a crucial role in advancing technology and enabling innovations in various industries. Play Video Job Description Date posted 07/28/2026 Category Engineering Hire Type Employee Job ID 15091 Remote Eligible No Date Posted 07/28/2026 Job Title: Principal ASIC Physical Design Engineer We Are Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. You Are You are the person teams turn to when timing closure looks impossible and the clock tree feels like a puzzle with missing pieces. You know the difference between a design that passes signoff and one that ships with margin to spare, because you have spent years making those calls at 7nm and below. You do not just push buttons in ICC2 or Prime Time—you know why a constraint matters, and you catch issues before they ripple downstream. When someone asks about integrating a tricky mixed-signal macro, you have a mental toolkit of what can go wrong and how to make it work. You thrive on the hard problems: GHz-level timing, power optimization, and the reality of silicon bring-up. You want your work to show up in real products, not just in a tapeout report. Sharing what you know is second nature—mentoring junior engineers, reviewing a teammate’s floorplan, or explaining a tradeoff to a colleague in the US. You care about getting the details right, but you do not get stuck in them. You move projects forward, ask the right questions, and always look for a better way to do things. What You'll Be Doing Implement and integrate Physical Design for ASICs at advanced nodes (10nm, 7nm, 6nm and below) using tools like Synopsys ICC2, Prime Time, and Star RC. Drive timing closure for high-frequency designs above 4GHz, handling constraint management, analysis, and optimization. Work hands-on with clock tree synthesis, skew balancing, and robust clock distribution for complex So Cs and IPs. Collaborate closely with teams in Bangalore and the US, joining technical discussions, design reviews, and troubleshooting sessions. Integrate mixed-signal hard macro IPs, solving unique interface and floorplan challenges as they arise. Mentor junior engineers, sharing best practices and elevating the team’s technical capability. Develop and optimize automation scripts in Tcl, Perl, or Python to streamline physical design flows and improve productivity. Support and improve methodologies for floorplanning, placement, routing, and power optimization. The Impact You Will Have Deliver HPC Controller IPs that will power the next wave of consumer and enterprise devices. Push Synopsys’ reputation for silicon-proven, high-performance IP at the most advanced process nodes. Raise the bar for quality and innovation in timing closure, clock tree synthesis, and mixed-signal integration. Help global teams align and execute, ensuring projects hit milestones and customers get what they need, on time. Enable faster, more robust tapeouts by improving design flows and mentoring the next generation of engineers. Influence product differentiation through hands-on technical contributions and creative problem solving. Shorten time-to-market for customers by anticipating and solving critical design challenges early. What You'll Need Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related field. 10+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC physical design at 10nm, 7nm, 6nm or below. Deep proficiency with Synopsys ICC2, Prime Time, Star RC, and similar industry tools. Demonstrated success in timing closure for high-frequency designs (4GHz and above), including constraint management and analysis. Practical experience integrating HPC Controller interface IPs and mixed-signal macros. Solid knowledge of scripting (Tcl, Perl, Python) for automating physical design tasks. Strong skills in debugging complex design and integration issues. Who You Are You explain why a timing violation matters, not just how to fix it, and adapt your message for a peer or a VP. When a design review gets stuck, you break down the complexity and help the team move forward. You spot risk early and act, rather than waiting for issues to escalate. Sharing knowledge is second nature—you mentor, document, and help others level up. You keep an eye on quality, even under pressure, and push for continuous improvement in tools and process. You are comfortable switching context between deep technical work and cross-site collaboration, always keeping the larger goal in view. title: Sr Staff Engineer, Formal Verification
jobDescription:
Job Description Benefits Culture How We Hire Overview Our Hardware Engineers at Synopsys are responsible for designing and developing cutting-edge semiconductor solutions. They work on intricate tasks such as chip architecture, circuit design, and verification to ensure the efficiency and reliability of semiconductor products. These engineers play a crucial role in advancing technology and enabling innovations in various industries. Play Video Job Description Date posted 07/27/2026 Category Engineering Hire Type Employee Job ID 18152 Remote Eligible No Date Posted 07/27/2026 Senior Staff Formal Verification Engineer We Are Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. You Are You have spent the better part of a decade proving that digital designs actually work, not just that they pass testbenches. Formal verification is where you live because you know that simulation can only show the presence of bugs, while formal methods can prove their absence. You have seen what happens when a corner case slips through, and you are the engineer who makes sure it does not. You understand RTL at a level that lets you read a design and immediately spot the edge cases that will break it. Temporal logic is not abstract theory to you, it is the language you use to describe what correct behavior actually means. You have worked with tools like Jasper or VC-Formal enough to know their strengths, their quirks, and when to push back on a proof that looks complete but is not. Mentoring comes naturally because you remember what it was like to debug your first failed assertion at 2am, and you would rather teach someone to set up a clean proof than fix their setup later. You can sit with a design team in Bangalore, walk through a formal verification plan, and leave them understanding not just what you are checking but why it matters. What You'll Be Doing Build and maintain an end-to-end formal verification flow that integrates cleanly into the broader verification process, not a standalone tool that lives in a corner Create formal verification plans that identify the key behaviors worth proving, then develop the assertions, assumptions, and cover properties that actually close on those behaviors Guide design and verification engineers on effective use of formal tools, reviewing setups and proofs to catch issues before they become blockers Maintain and extend assertion libraries that work for both simulation and formal contexts, ensuring consistency across verification approaches Apply formal techniques like bounded model checking, induction, and abstraction to prove correctness of complex RTL designs Debug RTL when proofs fail, tracing back from a counterexample to the root cause in the design or the verification environment Train team members and mentor junior engineers on formal methods, assertion-based verification, and debugging strategies The Impact You Will Have Catch design bugs that simulation would miss, preventing costly respins and schedule slips downstream Raise the quality bar for digital designs across Synopsys products by making formal verification a standard part of the process, not an afterthought Accelerate verification closure by proving corner cases formally instead of writing thousands of directed tests hoping to hit them Build verification infrastructure that other engineers can use effectively, multiplying your impact across the team Improve design quality at the source by working closely with RTL designers to identify and fix issues early Contribute to the silicon and IP solutions that power everything from AI accelerators to automotive systems Strengthen the formal verification capability of the Bangalore team through knowledge sharing and hands-on mentorship What You'll Need 8+ years of industry experience in digital design or verification, with at least 5 years focused on formal verification techniques Deep understanding of digital logic, RTL design patterns, and the synthesis and timing flows that turn RTL into gates Hands-on experience with Verilog or System Verilog and the ability to read and debug complex RTL quickly Solid grasp of temporal logic and assertion-based verification, including SVA or PSL Experience with at least one formal verification tool such as Jasper or VC-Formal, including setup, proof strategies, and debug Track record of using formal methods to close verification on complex projects, not just toy examples Bachelor's or master's in computer science or electrical engineering; experience with Python, Perl, or Shell scripting is a plus Who You Are You can look at a failed proof, trace the counterexample back through the design, and figure out whether the bug is in the RTL, the assumptions, or the assertion itself You explain formal verification concepts to someone who has only done simulation-based verification in a way that makes them want to try it, not run away from it You push back when a verification plan is too vague or when assumptions are hiding real design issues instead of simplifying the problem space You stay organized across multiple verification tasks, keeping track of which proofs are complete, which are bounded, and which need more work You collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams, whether that means a design review over video or a detailed written explanation of a proof strategy You mentor junior engineers by showing them how to think about formal verification, not just how to run a tool The Team You'll Be Part Of You will be part of the Solutions Group at the Bangalore Design Center, working with a team focused on delivering high-quality digital designs and verification solutions. The team values learning and growth, and you will have opportunities to work with talented engineers across different geographies and disciplines. Rewards and Benefits We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. We feel honored to work alongside such talented and passionate individuals who choose to make a difference here every day. We're proud to provide the comprehensive benefits and rewards that our team truly deserves. jobDescription:
Job Description Benefits Culture How We Hire Overview Our Hardware Engineers at Synopsys are responsible for designing and developing cutting-edge semiconductor solutions. They work on intricate tasks such as chip architecture, circuit design, and verification to ensure the efficiency and reliability of semiconductor products. These engineers play a crucial role in advancing technology and enabling innovations in various industries. Play Video Job Description Date posted 07/26/2026 Category Engineering Hire Type Employee Job ID 18084 Remote Eligible No Date Posted 07/26/2026 Job Title: So C RTL Design Engineer, Sr Staff We Are Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. You Are You have spent years building and signing off RTL that actually ships in silicon, not just passes simulation. The difference between a design that tapes out clean and one that comes back with a respin is usually a clock domain crossing someone missed or a constraint someone wrote too loosely, and you are the engineer who catches those things before they become problems. You know that static checks are not checkbox exercises, they are conversations with the design, and you have learned to read what Spyglass is actually telling you beneath the noise. You have debugged enough CDC violations to know which ones matter and which ones are artifacts of tool setup. You have written enough SDC to know when a constraint is fighting the architecture instead of describing it. Running synthesis is not a handoff for you, it is part of how you validate that your RTL decisions were sound. You do not need someone to tell you what good looks like, you have a point of view on design quality and you are comfortable defending it in a review. Working across IP integration, subsystem assembly, and full So C builds does not intimidate you. You have done it before, and you know how to move between abstraction levels without losing sight of what actually has to work in the end. What You'll Be Doing Run RTL quality signoff using Spyglass for LINT, CDC, and RDC checks across IP blocks, subsystems, and full So C designs Develop timing constraints in SDC for synthesis and static timing analysis, ensuring constraints accurately reflect design intent and architecture Execute preliminary synthesis runs using Design Compiler or Fusion Compiler to validate RTL synthesizability, area, and timing feasibility before handoff Perform formal equivalence checking with Formality to verify RTL-to-gate consistency across design revisions and ECOs Integrate third-party and Synopsys IP into customer So Cs and subsystems, resolving integration issues related to clocking, reset, and interface protocols Create and modify RTL design blocks to meet customer-specific requirements, working within established design guidelines and delivery timelines Collaborate with verification, implementation, and architecture teams to close signoff issues and ensure RTL quality gates are met before tapeout The Impact You Will Have Your signoff rigor directly reduces respin risk for customers building chips in advanced nodes where a single CDC bug can cost months and millions The constraints you write become the foundation for physical implementation teams to close timing, making or breaking their ability to meet PPA targets Your synthesis validation catches architectural mismatches early, preventing costly surprises downstream in place and route The IP integrations you deliver enable startups and tier-one customers to meet aggressive tapeout schedules with confidence in design quality Your expertise in static verification tools shapes internal methodology, raising the bar for what clean RTL means across the System Solutions Group The RTL you design and integrate becomes part of production So Cs powering AI, automotive, 5G, and Io T applications in the field Your work helps Synopsys customers tape out some of the most complex and challenging semiconductor designs in the industry What You'll Need Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering with 8+ years of hands-on experience in RTL design and verification Proven experience performing static verification using Spyglass or equivalent tools for LINT, CDC, and RDC analysis on complex digital designs Strong working knowledge of synthesis tools such as Design Compiler or Fusion Compiler, including constraint development and synthesis quality checks Hands-on experience with Formality or equivalent formal verification tools for RTL-to-gate equivalence checking Solid conceptual understanding of clock domain crossing, reset domain crossing, and common design pitfalls that lead to metastability or functional failures Experience integrating IP blocks into subsystems or So Cs, including resolving interface, clocking, and protocol issues Familiarity with scripting in Tcl, Python, or Perl to automate checks, reporting, and design flows is a strong plus Who You Are You can look at a CDC report with 500 violations and know within an hour which ten actually need fixing and which are tool noise or acceptable design choices You write constraints that implementation teams can actually use, not overly conservative SDC that makes timing impossible or loose constraints that let real problems slip through You push back when an architecture decision is going to create a signoff nightmare three months later, and you do it with enough specificity that people listen You are comfortable working with customers directly, translating their requirements into RTL decisions without needing everything spelled out in a specification You stay current on what good RTL practice looks like as nodes shrink and design complexity grows, and you bring that knowledge into reviews and mentoring You can context-switch between a 10-gate glue logic fix and a multi-thousand-line subsystem integration without losing attention to detail on either The Team You'll Be Part Of You will join the System Solutions Group, a team of specialists in Synopsys technologies who deliver architecture, design, verification, implementation, tools, and methodology to help customers complete their most challenging So C projects. The work spans from sub-blocks to full turnkey So Cs, and customers range from startups to industry leaders across commercial and government sectors. This is a global team working on real production designs that tape out and ship in silicon. Rewards and Benefits We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. title: SOC Engineering, Staff Engineer - RTL Design
jobDescription:
Job Description Benefits Culture How We Hire Overview Our Hardware Engineers at Synopsys are responsible for designing and developing cutting-edge semiconductor solutions. They work on intricate tasks such as chip architecture, circuit design, and verification to ensure the efficiency and reliability of semiconductor products. These engineers play a crucial role in advancing technology and enabling innovations in various industries. Play Video Job Description Date posted 07/26/2026 Category Engineering Hire Type Employee Job ID 18083 Remote Eligible No Date Posted 07/26/2026 Job Title: RTL Design Engineer, Staff Level
- So C Design We Are Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. You Are You have spent years in RTL design knowing that clean code at the front end saves weeks of pain downstream. You have learned the hard way that a missed clock domain crossing or an unchecked reset scheme does not just slow synthesis, it breaks trust with the implementation team counting on your work. You think in terms of signoff quality before tape-out pressure hits, not after. You are the engineer who opens Spyglass before the design review, not during integration panic. When you see a CDC violation, you do not just waive it, you trace it back to the architecture decision that caused it and you ask whether that decision still makes sense. You have written SDC constraints that actually reflect design intent, not just pass a tool check. Working across subsystems and full SOCs does not intimidate you. You have integrated third-party IP, debugged synthesis mismatches at 2 a.m., and run formality enough times to know when the issue is in the script versus the RTL. You care about the quality of what you hand off because you have been on the receiving end of messy handoffs before. At Synopsys, you will work on real customer SOC projects that ship into production, alongside a team that takes signoff seriously. What You'll Be Doing Run RTL quality signoff using Spyglass for LINT, CDC, and RDC checks across IP blocks, subsystems, and full SOC designs Develop and validate timing constraints in SDC format for synthesis and static timing analysis, ensuring design intent is captured correctly Execute preliminary synthesis runs using Design Compiler to verify RTL synthesizability, identify timing bottlenecks, and catch issues before implementation Perform formal equivalence checking with Formality between RTL and gate-level netlists to ensure functional correctness through the flow Integrate customer and third-party IP into subsystem and SOC-level RTL designs, managing hierarchy, interfaces, and design-for-test requirements Debug and resolve design issues related to clock domain crossings, reset schemes, and RTL coding violations in collaboration with architecture and verification teams Deliver signoff-quality RTL and constraint packages to implementation teams on customer projects ranging from startups to industry leaders The Impact You Will Have Enable faster, cleaner SOC tape-outs by catching design issues at the RTL stage instead of during physical implementation Reduce downstream respins and schedule risk by delivering synthesis-ready, formally verified RTL with accurate timing constraints Improve design quality and customer confidence across Synopsys System Solutions Group engagements spanning commercial and government projects Build reusable signoff methodologies and constraint templates that scale across multiple customer programs and technology nodes Strengthen cross-functional collaboration by providing implementation teams with RTL they can trust and constraints that reflect real design intent Contribute to the successful delivery of complex, high-stakes SOC projects where your signoff rigor directly affects product success Help define best practices for RTL quality and static verification within a team working on some of the industry's most challenging semiconductor designs What You'll Need Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field 4+ years of hands-on experience in RTL design, verification, or SOC integration Proven experience using Spyglass or equivalent tools for LINT, CDC, and RDC static verification Strong working knowledge of SDC timing constraint development and synthesis flows using Design Compiler or similar tools Solid understanding of clock domain crossing, reset domain crossing, and common RTL design pitfalls that affect timing and functionality Experience running formal equivalence checking with Formality or equivalent tools, experience with System Verilog and Verilog RTL coding is a plus Who You Are You can look at a CDC violation report and trace the root cause back to a clocking architecture decision without getting lost in the noise You write timing constraints that capture what the design actually needs, not just what makes the tool happy, and you can explain the difference You have debugged enough synthesis mismatches to know when the issue is a coding style problem versus a tool limitation versus a real functional bug You are comfortable working across time zones and directly with customer engineering teams who depend on your deliverables to keep their schedules on track You do not wait for perfect specs, you ask the right questions, make reasonable assumptions, document them, and move forward You take ownership of your signoff results and you push back when a waiver does not make technical sense, even if it is easier to let it slide The Team You'll Be Part Of You will join the System Solutions Group, a team of design, verification, and implementation experts who deliver full SOC solutions to customers using Synopsys technologies. The work spans from IP-level blocks to complete turnkey SOC projects for customers that include startups, established semiconductor companies, and government agencies. The team operates globally and collaborates across architecture, RTL design, verification, physical implementation, tools, and methodology. You will work on real production designs where quality and schedule both matter. Rewards and Benefits We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. title: Senior Staff R&D Engineer – C/C++, Python, Unix/Linux, scripting
jobDescription:
Job Description Benefits Culture How We Hire Overview Synopsys software engineers are key enablers in the world of Electronic Design Automation (EDA), developing and maintaining software used in chip design, verification and manufacturing. They work on assignments like designing, developing, and troubleshooting software, leveraging the state-of-the-art technologies like AI/ML, Gen AI and Cloud. Their critical contributions enable world-wide EDA designers to extend the frontiers of semiconductors and chip development. Play Video Job Description Date posted 04/27/2026 Category Engineering Hire Type Employee Job ID 16970 Remote Eligible No Date Posted 04/27/2026 We Are: At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation. You Are: You are a driven and passionate engineer who thrives on solving complex system-level challenges. You possess deep technical expertise in C/C++ and Unix/Linux internals, and you bring a security-first mindset to every line of code you write. You enjoy architecting scalable, robust, and high-performance software that serves as the backbone for mission-critical products. Your curiosity keeps you up-to-date with the latest advancements in licensing systems, application security, and cryptography. You take pride in delivering reliable solutions that protect intellectual property and enable business growth. You are a natural collaborator who communicates effectively across functions and geographies, ensuring alignment and clarity in development goals. You are comfortable taking ownership and initiative, proactively identifying potential risks and proposing innovative solutions. Your attention to detail and commitment to engineering excellence set you apart as a technical leader. You thrive in a fast-paced environment where your analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities are constantly challenged. You value continuous learning, embrace new technologies, and are motivated by the impact your work has on both product quality and customer trust. What You’ll Be Doing: Contribute to R&D initiatives focused on software security and licensing technologies at Synopsys. Design, develop, enhance, and deploy Synopsys Common Licensing solutions from concept through production. Ensure licensing and security solutions operate reliably across heterogeneous Unix environments . Identify complex technical problems and deliver robust, scalable, and high‑quality system-level solutions . Support product excellence through a strong focus on performance, reliability, accuracy, and robustness . Stay current with advancements in licensing systems, application security, and cryptography . Collaborate effectively across teams to meet aggressive development timelines. The Impact You Will Have: Protect Synopsys’ intellectual property with secure and reliable licensing infrastructure, safeguarding our innovations. Directly contribute to customer trust and revenue protection through robust licensing and security mechanisms. Drive Synopsys’ leadership in the industry by delivering high-quality, scalable, and secure system software. Empower product teams worldwide by providing a strong, reliable foundation for feature-rich solutions. Enhance the overall security posture of Synopsys products, ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices. Support ongoing innovation by enabling rapid yet secure development and deployment cycles. What You’ll Need: 8-10 years of hands-on development experience in C/C++, with a strong emphasis on system-level programming for Unix/Linux environments. Deep understanding of Unix signals, multi-threading and synchronization mechanisms, socket programming, networking concepts, Unix system calls, and OS internals. Solid foundation in data structures and algorithms , enabling efficient and robust software design. Demonstrated knowledge of software security concepts and cryptographic algorithms. Proficiency in scripting languages such as Perl and Python for automation and tooling. Experience with debugging tools (e.g., gdb or equivalent) for troubleshooting complex system software. Exposure to assembly programming is a plus; familiarity with FLEXlm or licensing systems is desirable but not mandatory. Who You Are: Highly self-driven and motivated, with the ability to operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments. Exceptional problem-solving and analytical thinking skills. Capable of making sound technical decisions with good judgment and clear rationale. Demonstrates strong ownership, accountability, and meticulous attention to detail. Willingness and ability to continuously learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies. Collaborative team player with a passion for engineering excellence and shared success. The Team You’ll Be A Part Of: You will join a highly skilled team responsible for building and maintaining the core licensing and security infrastructure that underpins Synopsys products. The team’s focus is on driving innovation, security, and performance in system-level software that operates across a wide variety of platforms. As a foundational group, you will enable product teams worldwide to deliver feature-rich solutions without compromising on security or reliability. Collaboration, technical excellence, and a commitment to continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do. Rewards and Benefits: We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. title: STA PrimeTime Test & Validation Sr Specialist
jobDescription:
requirement analysis through quality sign-off and customer readiness Define validation strategy, coverage depth, and risk-based testing plans for advanced timing scenarios including OCV, AOCV, POCV, path-based analysis, ECO flows, and hierarchical STA Lead technical debugging of complex, cross-component issues reported by customers or found in regression, driving root cause analysis and collaborating with R&D to validate fixes Architect and enhance automation frameworks using Perl, Tcl, and Python to improve regression robustness, testcase coverage, and validation productivity Mentor L1 and L2 validation engineers on STA concepts, debugging techniques, testcase design, and validation best practices Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools like Cursor, VS Code with LLMs, and other productivity accelerators to speed up script development, log analysis, and hypothesis generation, while applying technical judgment to validate all AI-generated outputs Prepare and present executive-ready validation status reports, quality metrics, risk assessments, and sign-off recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders The Impact You Will Have Directly improve Prime Time product quality and customer sign-off readiness by catching critical issues before they reach the field Reduce customer-reported bugs and escalations through proactive, risk-based validation and deep scenario coverage Influence product roadmap and design decisions by providing validation-driven insights on feature robustness, scalability, and real-world usability Elevate team capability and validation rigor by mentoring engineers and driving adoption of modern automation and AI-assisted productivity tools Strengthen cross-team alignment and trust by serving as a technical bridge between Product Validation, R&D, Product Engineering, and Field teams Accelerate time to quality sign-off by architecting smarter regression frameworks and leveraging data analysis to identify systemic gaps early Set the standard for validation discipline, documentation quality, and technical ownership across the Prime Time validation organization What You'll Need Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering with 5+ years of hands-on validation or verification experience, or Master's degree with 4+ years Deep understanding of Static Timing Analysis fundamentals including setup/hold analysis, clock domain crossing, multi-mode multi-corner analysis, and timing constraints Strong hands-on experience with Synopsys Prime Time or equivalent industry STA tools in real sign-off or validation contexts Proven ability to debug complex, ambiguous issues across large codebases and multi-component systems, driving them to root cause Proficiency in Perl, Tcl, and Python for building automation frameworks, testcase generation, and data analysis Experience with advanced STA flows such as OCV/AOCV/POCV, derates, path-based analysis, ECO flows, what-if analysis, and hierarchical or distributed timing sign-off Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools responsibly to enhance productivity, with the technical judgment to validate and refine AI-generated code, scripts, or analysis Who You Are You can take an ambiguous customer bug report, reproduce the scenario in your validation environment, isolate the root cause, and explain it clearly to R&D without needing three follow-up meetings You think in terms of risk and coverage, not just pass/fail, and you proactively identify the corner cases and stress conditions that standard regression suites miss You review testcases and automation scripts with a critical eye, catching logic gaps, scalability issues, and maintainability problems before they become technical debt You are comfortable presenting validation status, quality metrics, and risk assessments to senior technical leaders and product managers, translating detailed findings into clear recommendations You mentor engineers not by giving answers but by teaching them how to debug, how to think about coverage, and how to build robust validation strategies You use AI tools to accelerate your work, but you never trust an output you have not personally validated, and you know when to override a suggestion based on your domain expertise The Team You'll Be Part Of Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. Rewards and Benefits We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. #TPG At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. title: Program Management (Technical), Principal
jobDescription:
requirements through silicon bring-up, ensuring delivery against committed schedules and specifications Serve as the primary technical and operational point of contact between customers and Synopsys cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, FAE, CAE, and R&D Plan and drive program schedules across standard IP deliveries, custom IP development, and foundry process technology node transitions Identify, track, and escalate technical and schedule risks, driving issues to resolution across internal development teams and external customer stakeholders Coordinate IP integration activities with customer So C design teams, ensuring successful acquisition, integration, and silicon validation Translate customer So C requirements into actionable development plans, working with R&D to align IP roadmaps with customer product timelines Communicate program status, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders at multiple levels, from engineering teams to executive leadership The Impact You Will Have Enable customers to meet their So C tape-out schedules by delivering IP on time and to specification, directly affecting their product launch timelines Reduce customer integration risk by proactively identifying and resolving technical issues before they impact silicon bring-up Expand Synopsys IP footprint in customer roadmaps by identifying opportunities for future So C programs based on deep program engagement Improve cross-functional execution by creating clarity across geographically distributed teams, reducing miscommunication and rework Strengthen customer relationships through consistent delivery and technical credibility, turning program success into long-term partnerships Influence internal IP development priorities by bringing customer voice and real-world integration challenges back to R&D teams Shape how Synopsys executes complex, high-stakes programs by setting the standard for technical program management in the Silicon IP business What You'll Need Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent with 10 to 15+ years of relevant experience in program management or technical leadership roles Proven track record managing programs in analog and digital So C design environments, with demonstrated ability to deliver complex technical programs on schedule Deep knowledge of IC manufacturing, process technology, design flow, and sign-off processes, with the ability to speak credibly with customer engineering teams Understanding of memory and standard cell design, including how IP integrates into So C design flows and what can go wrong during integration Experience working directly with customers in a technical or program capacity, managing expectations and navigating complex stakeholder environments Ability to manage multiple concurrent programs with competing priorities, making clear trade-off decisions and keeping teams aligned Strong technical communication skills, you can explain a complex integration issue to a customer architect and translate it into an actionable plan for internal R&D Who You Are You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to their So C requirements, and come out with a clear understanding of what they actually need versus what they said they need You know when to escalate and when to solve, and you do not let issues sit hoping they will resolve themselves You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, you can start a program with incomplete requirements and drive the right conversations to fill in the gaps without stalling progress You manage up and down effectively, keeping executives informed without over-communicating and keeping engineering teams focused without micromanaging You have the technical depth to challenge an unrealistic schedule or a risky integration approach, and the credibility to make that challenge stick You think about the customer's success as your success, and you take ownership of program outcomes even when the path to get there is messy The Team You'll Be Part Of Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. title: Site Reliability, Staff
jobDescription:
Job Description Benefits Culture How We Hire Overview Synopsys software engineers are key enablers in the world of Electronic Design Automation (EDA), developing and maintaining software used in chip design, verification and manufacturing. They work on assignments like designing, developing, and troubleshooting software, leveraging the state-of-the-art technologies like AI/ML, Gen AI and Cloud. Their critical contributions enable world-wide EDA designers to extend the frontiers of semiconductors and chip development. Play Video Job Description Date posted 03/04/2026 Category Information Technology Hire Type Employee Job ID 15510 Remote Eligible No Date Posted 03/04/2026 We Are We are a technology organization operating high performance, large scale Linux production environments that support critical platforms and engineering teams. Our focus is on operational excellence, service reliability, automation, and continuous improvement. We run 24x7 operations and partner closely with platform, network, security, and engineering teams to deliver stable, secure, and scalable infrastructure. You Are You are an experienced people manager and technical leader with a strong background in Linux operations and Site Reliability Engineering. You thrive in high availability, always on environments, are comfortable leading teams through production incidents, and are passionate about automation, reliability, and building strong operational teams. What You’ll Be Doing • Leading and managing a 24x7 L1 Linux Engineering / SRE team operating in rotational shifts • Owning hiring, onboarding, performance management, coaching, and career development for L1 engineers • Owning L1 production support operations for Linux systems in a 24x7 environment • Acting as the first leadership escalation point during major production incidents • Ensuring adherence to SLAs, OLAs, and operational KPIs such as availability and MTTR • Providing technical oversight across Linux OS, bare metal and virtualized platforms, and monitoring/logging systems • Driving automation adoption using Ansible, Bash, and Python to reduce manual toil • Defining and maintaining SOPs, runbooks, escalation procedures, and documentation • Partnering with platform, network, security, and engineering teams to improve system reliability and resilience The Impact You Will Have • Ensuring stable, reliable, and efficient 24x7 L1 Linux/SRE operations • Reducing incident recurrence and improving incident response and resolution times • Building a skilled, motivated, and well governed L1 engineering team • Improving operational maturity through automation, standardization, and documentation • Enabling engineering and R&D teams through predictable and resilient platform operations What You’ll Need • 10–14+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure, Linux Operations, or SRE • 4–6+ years of people management experience, preferably managing 24x7 support teams • Strong hands on background in Linux system administration and production support • Experience with incident management, on call models, and rotational shifts • Advanced knowledge of Linux OS internals • Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, KVM, Open Stack, o Virt) • Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Nagios, ELK) • Experience with automation and configuration management (Ansible) • Scripting skills in Bash and/or Python Who You Are • A strong people leader with excellent coaching and decision making skills • Calm and effective under high pressure production scenarios • Highly structured and data driven in driving operational excellence • An effective communicator and stakeholder partner • Passionate about reliability engineering, automation, and continuous improvement The Team You’ll Be A Part Of You will lead and be part of a Linux Engineering / Site Reliability Engineering organization responsible for frontline (L1) production support. The team works closely with L2/L3 engineering, platform, network, security, and R&D teams to ensure reliable and scalable infrastructure operations across the business. Rewards and Benefits • Opportunity to lead mission critical, large scale Linux and SRE operations • High visibility role with exposure to senior leadership and engineering stakeholders • Ability to shape operational strategy, automation, and reliability practices • Strong focus on career growth, learning, and leadership development At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. Apply Save Job test Share Email Linked In X Facebook Benefits At Synopsys, innovation is driven by our incredible team around the world. We feel honored to work alongside such talented and passionate individuals who choose to make a difference here every day. We're proud to provide the comprehensive benefits and rewards that our team truly deserves. Visit Benefits Page Health & Wellness Comprehensive medical and healthcare plans that work for you and your family. Time Away In addition to company holidays, we have ETO and FTO Programs. Family Support Maternity and paternity leave, parenting resources, adoption and surrogacy assistance, and more. ESPP Purchase Synopsys common stock at a 15% discount, with a 24 month look-back. Retirement Plans Save for your future with our retirement plans that vary by region and country. Compensation Competitive salaries. ** Benefits vary by country and region
